scientific_integrity: Self-contained mathematical argument with explicit binomial Chernoff gap and strong induction. Independent review has not been performed. Code and rational finite tests are auxiliary checks, not proofs of the all-length theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fair independent binary input only; no sharp upper bound for maximum residual weight, no limiting normalization constant, no biased-source exponent. The bound controls the expected residual length and gives only an existential lower bound for residual ones.
title: Sharp golden-ratio exponent for the mean residual of exhaustive Peres extraction
